test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following reports is considered as a piecemeal effort to provide resilience to the successful working of federal system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarkaria Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sarkaria Commission was constituted in **1983** by the Government of India to review the working of the **Indian federal system** and suggest reforms for strengthening it.
 
• The Commission focused on recommending measures to ensure better coordination between the **Centre and the States**, addressing grievances of states while maintaining national unity.
 
• It emphasized the need for cooperative federalism and suggested several reforms to provide resilience to the federal system.
 
• Its recommendations covered various aspects, including **legislative relations, administrative relations, financial relations, and emergency provisions**.
 
• Many of its suggestions have been used as a reference point in debates and policies to ensure smooth functioning of the Centre-State relations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Federal System in India**

 
 
• India follows a **quasi-federal system**, where the Constitution provides for a strong Centre along with state governments with defined powers.
 
• The distribution of powers is enumerated in the **Union List, State List, and Concurrent List** under the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Important Recommendations of Sarkaria Commission**
 
 
• Strengthen the role of the Inter-State Council for resolving disputes between states and the Centre.
 
• Restrict the misuse of **Article 356 (President’s Rule)** and ensure its application only in exceptional circumstances.
 
• Encourage decentralization by empowering states and local bodies.
 
 
 
• **Other Commissions and Their Purposes**
 
 
• **Kothari Commission (1964-66):** Focused on reforms in the education system of India.
 
• **Thakkar Commission (1984):** Investigated the assassination of Indira Gandhi.
 
• **Kapur Commission:** Investigated the conspiracy behind the assassination of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
 
 
• **Inter-State Council**
 
 
• It is a constitutional body under **Article 263** of the Indian Constitution, aimed at resolving disputes and fostering cooperation between the Centre and States.
 
• It was set up based on the recommendation of the Sarkaria Commission in **1990**.
